title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Move Date for Room-Change Pricing
content:
**Admissions and billing joint guidance — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The move date of a room-change credit — the day from which the advance for the room the resident left is given back — follows the agreement's records.

**Requested moves to a dearer room.** A move the resident requests reprices from the move date, save that a requested move into a tier whose daily rate under the current private pay schedule is higher than that of the tier the resident left, where the resident's latest room-change request was logged on or before the move date recorded on the agreement and names a later date inside the span of the advance charge billed for the room the resident left, reprices from that requested date, the resident not being charged the higher rate before the date asked for, and both the room-change credit on that advance and the new room's span reprice from it; every other move reprices from the move date.

**The move date, case by case.**

| Records | Move date |
|---|---|
| The move reprices from the date named by the resident's latest room-change request under the rule above | That requested date |
| Not so, and the agreement records the move before the first day of the charge's span | The first day of the charge's span |
| Neither | The move date recorded on the agreement |

The resident's latest room-change request is the one logged latest; where two were logged at the same moment, the one entered first.

| Accommodation tier | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 514.00 |

**Points of judgement.** A requested move into a tier whose current rate is lower than the old room's: the recorded move date stands, whatever date the request names. A request logged after the recorded move: the recorded date stands. A request naming a day after the old room's span ends: the recorded date stands. A move recorded two days before the span begins, with no request applying: the move date is the span's first day.
